title: acs <skill>-state.json
description: Per-skill state file in the ticket partition. The append-only `runs` array is the single source of truth for status: runs[-1].status is the current state; pre-hooks gate on it. Status, stop reason, and timestamps are never mirrored at top level. `skill` and `ticket_id` echo the filename/partition deliberately, so the file stays self-describing after archiving.

states.description: The skill's current result data, consumed by the next skill. Re-runs update it in place. The load-bearing members are declared (ADR-0093): `verifier_passed` is /acs:create-pr's merge gate, `plan_approved` /acs:code's plan-conformance activation, `pr` what /acs:merge-pr merges, `tests` and `review` what the PR body and /acs:metrics report; a skill adding a member declares it here. Per-skill members not listed stay open (additionalProperties).

verifier_passed.description: DERIVED by post-code.py from the verifier's own verdict document (MAR-527), never trusted from the result document; /acs:create-pr's brake refuses unless it is true.

plan_approved.description: Written by plan-approval.py alone (MAR-73); false on TRIVIAL/SMALL and on an ineligible plan.

file_map.description: /acs:create-impl-plan: executor task number -> the files that task may write (the file-map guard's declared map).

pr.description: /acs:create-pr records it; /acs:merge-pr reads it. `number` and `url` come from the forge, `branch` is the ticket branch, `base` the branch the PR targets.

review.description: The reflection loop as it ran: `iterations` is derived from the verify artifacts on disk, `guard_denials` from runs[-1].guard_events (both MAR-523/MAR-578, never trusted from the document); `findings_open` is what /acs:docs-sync reports.

tests.description: Derived from the last iteration's verdict (the verifier's own run of the full suite, the only one /acs:code takes): `passed`/`failed`/`coverage_percent` from its recorded command output, `coverage_target` from settings.test_coverage_percent. Falls back to the execute reports when the verdict carries no numbers -- a docs-only ticket, a run that ended before any verifier wrote one, or state from before the verdict carried them (MAR-523).

merged.description: /acs:merge-pr: true only when the PR is confirmed MERGED on the forge.

findings.description: Anything worth passing on: review findings, user clarifications, gotchas. Latest run's view (replaced on re-run). Each entry carries a `severity` because the release gate and /acs:create-pr's brake read `blocking` as a verdict (ADR-0093).

cost_basis.description: Never fabricated, never zero-padded: absent/unavailable means no dollar figure is claimed.

cost_scope.description: "session_total"/"main_session_only" on a measured or apportioned charge; cost_sampler.allocate_cost also reuses this field as the degraded reason ("no_unconsumed_sample_in_window"/"cost_total_reset") when cost_usd is null -- verified against the module's own real return values, not just the design's abstract two-value description.

api_duration_basis.description: Never fabricated, never zero-padded: absent/unavailable means no duration figure is claimed.

api_duration_scope.description: Distinct from cost_scope: cost_sampler.allocate_cost's api_duration_scope carries its own 5th value ("duration_unavailable_on_cursor") that cost_scope never emits, so the two fields are declared separately rather than sharing one enum.

role_usage.description: Per-role measured token/cost buckets (usage_reader/cost_sampler); a 'role': 'unattributed' entry counts toward the apportionment denominator but never receives a dollar share.

model_usage.description: Per-model measured token/cost buckets (usage_reader/cost_sampler), parallel to role_usage; cost_usd is the FULL charged delta apportioned by token share with no unattributed exclusion (D1.2 Option A), so its sum can exceed role_usage's attributed-only cost sum by excluded_cost_usd.

guard_events.description: File-map guard denials recorded on this run (MAR-578): one entry per deny, in occurrence order, appended by acs_lib.filemap. Never written on a fail-open branch, and never able to change the deny it describes. Optional and forward-only: a run finalized before it shipped carries none.

target.description: Repo-relative when the denied path is under checkout_root, else as given; null for unreadable_payload, where no path is nameable.

gate_enforcement.description: Whether this run could confirm acs's hook gates were enforcing it (MAR-583), written at run start by skill-start.py from acs_lib.hostgates.gate_evidence -- evidence (the PreToolUse(Skill) session marker), never inference about the host. The evidence is recorded fail-open (MAR-514), so `gated: false` records the absence of that evidence and never establishes that the gate did not fire. Optional and forward-only: a run started before it shipped carries none, and a run REFUSED under hook_gates.when_absent=refuse never becomes a run entry at all, so this only ever describes a run that started.

gated.description: True only on accepted evidence that the PreToolUse(Skill) gate fired for this run; false means no such evidence, which is weaker than proof that it did not fire.

reason.description: Which condition decided the verdict (e.g. gate_marker_accepted, no_gate_marker, marker_already_consumed). An open string, not an enum: the vocabulary lives in acs_lib.hostgates and grows as new ways for evidence to fail are found, and enumerating it here would make every addition retroactively invalidate old state files.

response.description: settings.hook_gates.when_absent as resolved for this run; warn (the default) never blocks.

unconfirmed.description: The enforcements acs_lib.HOOK_ENFORCEMENTS names, which this run found no evidence for; empty on a gated run. Named for what the evidence supports: the marker write is fail-open (MAR-514), so its absence never establishes that an enforcement was not in force.

notice.description: The degraded-enforcement notice as printed to stderr; null on a gated run.

handoff_summary.description: Required when status is handed_off: what is done, in flight, next actions, pending decisions.
